::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 23d 1884  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

[Sir](people/person_1652.qmd)

I should be very glad of the establishment of the copy right system with [America](organizations/other_172.qmd)but I should like to have more information before joining the [Company of Authors](organizations/other_44.qmd).

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** The letter evidently relates to the foundation of the Society of Authors in 1884;  Besant was the prime mover in the organisation but the letter may have been addressed to a colleague.
